results.title: Distributed Key Management for Cloud Apps
results.content: Native services, AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault (including Managed HSM), and Google Cloud KMS, offer unexportable keys, FIPS-validated modules, tight IAM/RBAC integration, and multi-region replication options. A pragmatic pattern for many enterprises is a central enterprise key manager as the system of record, with per-cloud envelope keys in native KMSs. You maintain key policy, cryptoperiod, and rotation cadence in the central system and use cloud-native KMS for high-throughput envelope encryption near the data. Many enterprises blend the two: use quorum-backed external KMS or HSMs to guard root or wrapping keys with secret sharing, then rely on cloud KMS or HSM replication for high-throughput envelope encryption close to data.
